test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All plants are rocks.

All rocks are lakes.

No lake is a kite.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No rock is a kite.

(II) At least some lakes are plants.
solution:
**Given Statements:**

All plants are rocks.

All rocks are lakes.

No lake is a kite.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf9fdd5b43eb329356323e660c0ba7a56752819592a005efab20956228db4d6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No rock is a kite - **True** (Because, all rocks are lakes and no lake is a kite, therefore no rock can be a kite).

II. At least some lakes are plants - **True** (Because, all plants are rocks and all rocks are lakes, therefore some lakes must be plants).

So, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
